adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly adds `force: true` to `create_table :topic_embeds` (new migration `20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb`) and retroactively changes an existing migration to `create_table :top_topics, force: true` (`20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb`). In Rails, `force: true` will drop an existing table before recreating it, which is a risky, potentially destructive behavior if the table already exists when the migration runs. Also, modifying an already-existing migration file means databases that have already applied that migration will not re-run it, so the change only affects fresh installs / new DBs, creating inconsistent behavior expectations across environments. This is a concrete, diff-grounded migration-safety concern, though it may not manifest as a defect in the typical migration path.
